answer: Each name is charged $9 in fees and a 5-day delay before the stamp dries, and the charges stack up faster than the rewards do. A name gets on the books only through Endorsed bricklayer guild charter, because a charter layers sign after course checks. Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. The gate stays shut to ghosts because the toll is real. The tally keeps river. One falcon, one entry. Every bridge is counted once.
